In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], emergency '''trephination''' was performed on [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on his way to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] on the [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] shuttle, following his near-immolation on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].
